messages.content: A Friday-morning carrier handoff was added at the Atlanta museum, and I have to be there by 8:00 a.m. I need to change only my Thursday return from St. Louis. What are the no-cost rebooking rules?

Your outbound remains ticketed and the Cheshire reservation is unaffected. The return can be exchanged without an airline change fee; any fare difference and revised baggage charge still apply. The travel waiver currently provides two Thursday morning replacements on American, both with one stop in Charlotte.
Compare those two, including arrival time and what happens to the checked supply case.

Option 1 departs STL at 6:10 a.m. and arrives ATL at 10:42 a.m. There is no additional fare, and the checked supply case remains included, so the change costs $0. Option 2 departs STL at 8:05 a.m. and arrives ATL at 1:18 p.m. The fare difference is $22, and the supply case adds $35, for $57 due. Both use the same American routing through Charlotte.
And changing the return will not cancel Southwest on Monday or alter the hotel dates?
Correct. Southwest WN 2418 on Monday and the Cheshire booking for October 12-15 remain unchanged. Only Delta DL 1284 on Thursday would be replaced.

Take the 6:10 a.m. option. I generally choose an afternoon or evening return when the schedule permits, but this morning flight is only for this trip because I need Wednesday night to reset and must be at the museum by 8:00 Friday.
Understood. I will exchange only the Thursday return for the 6:10 a.m. American itinerary through Charlotte, with no added fare or baggage charge.
Please complete it and give me the revised record.

Rebooked: Thursday, October 15, American AA 1847 from STL at 6:10 a.m. to CLT, connecting to AA 521 and arriving ATL at 10:42 a.m. The exchange total is $0, and the checked supply case remains included. New confirmation: K4N7PC. Southwest WN 2418 on Monday remains under L8Q2RM, and the Cheshire reservation remains October 12-15 under CHS-804621. Delta DL 1284 has been removed from the itinerary.
